title: EPS network feature support
text: The network may include this IE to inform the UE of the support of certain features. If this IE is not included then the UE shall interpret this as a receipt of an information element with all bits of the value part coded as zero, except for the S1-u data transfer (S1-U data) (octet 4, bit 2)
NOTE: In this exceptional case, the UE deems that the network supports S1-u data transfer
